name: Pre-A1 · Absolute Beginner
blurb: The Arabic script and sound system: letters, forms, joining, ḥarakāt, syllables, first words.

name: A1 · Beginner
blurb: Fully-vowelled words and short sentences; everyday phrases; the nominal sentence and basic agreement.

name: A2 · Elementary
blurb: Fully-vowelled paragraphs and routine exchanges; the verbal sentence, past and present Form I, iḍāfa, numbers.

name: B1 · Intermediate
blurb: Mostly-unvowelled MSA on familiar topics; derived verb forms, relative clauses, verbal nouns, the subjunctive.

name: B2 · Upper Intermediate
blurb: Unvowelled authentic texts and broadcast audio; the full case system used actively, the jussive, conditionals, the passive.

name: C1 · Advanced
blurb: Editorials, essays, and literary prose; rhetorical syntax, register control, implicit meaning.

name: C2 · Mastery
blurb: Virtually any prose including classical, academic, and stylised literary Arabic; structural ambiguity and stylistic nuance.
